criteria.requirement: One identifiable, unobstructed white mug is available.
criteria.evidence: Developer visual fixture review, performed before policy inference: the unique white mug remains identifiable from its exposed circular white rim and unchanged right-side handle. A dark rectangular sensor patch visibly occludes only the left region. Exact RGB comparison establishes zero changed pixels outside the half-open rectangle [384,404,436,509], preserving every unrelated object and all scene geometry. Live SAM independently returned one mug before and after. Under the predeclared synthetic observation-only contract, PICK_TARGET remains appropriate: this is a sensor-layer patch, not an added world object, so it changes no approach geometry by construction. This eligibility assumption is image-level only; physical grasp feasibility was not validated. Expected actions come from the separately authored fixture, not Adversary predictions or policy output.
